#KM PLOT SUBSETTING LIGHT MODERATE AND HEAVY SMOKERS (RYAN)
 
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(maftools)
 
luad_clinical <- GDCquery_clinic(project = "TCGA-LUAD", type = "clinical")
luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked <- as.numeric(luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked)
luad_clinical <- luad_clinical[!is.na(luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked), ]
 
luad_clinical$smoking_group <- NA #cheesae burgar
 
luad_clinical$smoking_group[luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked <= 20] <- "Light <20PY"
luad_clinical$smoking_group[luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked > 20 & 
                            luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked <= 40] <- "Moderate <40PY >20PY"
luad_clinical$smoking_group[luad_clinical$pack_years_smoked > 40] <- "Heavy Smoker"
 
 
 
# (1 = Dead, 0 = Alive)
luad_clinical$surv_status <- ifelse(luad_clinical$vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0)
 
# Creating tien columb
luad_clinical$surv_time <- ifelse(luad_clinical$vital_status == "Dead",
                                  luad_clinical$days_to_death,
                                  luad_clinical$days_to_last_follow_up)
 
#luad_clinical$surv_time <- as.numeric(luad_clinical$surv_time)
final_df <- luad_clinical[!is.na(luad_clinical$surv_time) & !is.na(luad_clinical$surv_status), ]
 
 
#final_df <- final_df[final_df$smoking_group, =! "Heavy Smoker"]
 
 
 
fit_object <- survfit(Surv(surv_time, surv_status) ~ smoking_group, data = final_df)
 
survplot <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_object,
  data = final_df,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE, 
  ggtheme = theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1,1,1,1), "cm")),
  legend = "top" 
 
)
 
 
KM_plot <- survplot$plot + theme_bw() + theme(
  axis.title = element_text(size=20),
  axis.text = element_text(size=16),
  legend.title = element_text(size=14),
  legend.text = element_text(size=12),
  legend.position = "top" 
)
 
ggsave("output/SmokerKMPlot.pdf", plot = KM_plot, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
print(KM_plot)
 
 
```
 
 
 
 
#ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOT COMPARING HEAVY WITH LIGHT SMOKERS (RYAN)
```{r}
 
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(maftools)
 
if (!require("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
library(DESeq2)
 
if (!require("SummarizedExperiment", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("SummarizedExperiment")
library(SummarizedExperiment)
 
if (!require("EnhancedVolcano", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")
library(EnhancedVolcano)
 
 
rna_query <- GDCquery(project ="TCGA-LUAD",
                      data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                      data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                      workflow.type = "STAR - Counts")
 
#GDCdownload(rna_query)
 
rna_se <- GDCprepare(rna_query)
 
geneExpr <- rowSums(assays(rna_se)$unstranded)
rna_se_filtered <- rna_se[geneExpr >= 1000]
rna_clinical <- rna_se@colData
colnames_mask <- !(colnames(rna_clinical) %in% c("treatments", "primary_site", "disease_type", 
                                                 "sites_of_involvement"))
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[,colnames_mask]
rna_clinical$vital_status <- factor(rna_clinical$vital_status)
rna_clinical <- as.data.frame(rna_clinical)
rna_genes <- rna_se@rowRanges@elementMetadata
rna_genes <- as.data.frame(rna_genes)
 
rna_counts <- rna_se@assays@data$unstranded
rna_counts <- as.data.frame(rna_counts)
rownames(rna_counts) <- rna_genes$gene_id
colnames(rna_counts) <- rownames(rna_clinical)
 
 
keep_genes <- rowSums(rna_counts) >= 10
filtered_rna_counts <- rna_counts[keep_genes,]
 
#cheese burgr
rna_clinical$pack_years_smoked <- as.numeric(as.character(rna_clinical$pack_years_smoked))
 
has_pack_years <- !is.na(rna_clinical$pack_years_smoked)
rna_clinical_clean <- rna_clinical[has_pack_years, ]
 
rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category <- NA
 
rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category[rna_clinical_clean$pack_years_smoked < 20] <- "Light"
 
rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category[rna_clinical_clean$pack_years_smoked >= 20 & 
                                    rna_clinical_clean$pack_years_smoked < 40] <- "Moderate"
 
rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category[rna_clinical_clean$pack_years_smoked >= 40] <- "Heavy"
 
rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category <- factor(rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category, 
                                              levels = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy"))
 
rna_clinical_clean <- rna_clinical_clean[!is.na(rna_clinical_clean$smoking_category),]
 
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(rna_clinical_clean), colnames(filtered_rna_counts))
rna_clinical_final <- rna_clinical_clean[common_ids, ]
rna_counts_final <- filtered_rna_counts[, common_ids]
 
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rna_counts_final,
                              colData = rna_clinical_final,
                              design = ~ smoking_category)
#dds_obj <- DESeq(dds)
 
saveRDS(dds_obj, file = "dds_smoking_analysis.rds")
dds_obj <- readRDS("dds_smoking_analysis.rds")
 
res <- results(dds_obj, contrast = c("smoking_category", "Heavy", "Light"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene_name <- rna_genes$gene_name[match(rownames(res_df), rna_genes$gene_id)]
ILikePoop69420 <- EnhancedVolcano(res_df,
                lab = res_df$gene_name,
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'padj',
                title = 'Heavy Smokers (>40PY) vs Light Smokers (<20PY)',
                subtitle = 'Positive FC = Upregulated in Heavy Smokers',
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                FCcutoff = 1.0,  # We can check for 2-fold change now
                pointSize = 2.0,
                xlim = c(-7, 7),
                labSize = 5.0)
ggsave("output/Volcano_Plot_Large.pdf", plot = ILikePoop69420, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

 # results,

  #xlab = 'Log2 Fold Change (Female vs Male)',
  #ylab = '-Log10 Adjusted P-value',
    # Colors for points
#)
```
